census.condition: Origin must remain in a valid generated/saved/registered/nonmoving root until frame publication; arbitrary raw movable C input is rejected
Native allocation may fail before taking over custody; initialize descriptor and cells before publication; no GC allocation in preparing region
Accepted operation gets stable VM/owner/domain/activation identity before admission cutoff; an old accepted preparation may finish publishing after cutoff
Provisional candidate and existing committed RC payload are separate scan slots; registration on processor 1 cannot rely on processor-zero-only mark_rc
Fully initialized mutable root cells become collector-visible before dropping origin custody; descriptor publication is not application commit
Mutable preparation no longer blocks GC once scannable frame and stop record are accepted; storage pin remains owned without excluding scanner writeback
Park means no root mutation, not an OS wait that prevents the processor from running the selected GC sync operation
Collector uses admitted VM adapters including nonzero owner and rewrites all moved slot values; marker still-body scan composes with base root model
Resume acquire-observes GC completion and reloads cell; rejects stale epoch/generation or stale C local before initializing marker
Marker allocation follows handoff; initial #f body then current rooted proc; transfer accepted only with initialized externally held still marker
Committed receipt and known terminal guard are distinct from response delivery; unknown running operation must still park before a later GC
Root reachability does not revive a killed C activation; restored continuation cannot reuse retired frame capability; new execution receives new operation identity

settle.condition: Do not withdraw origin before a collector-visible root frame has custody
Preparation must terminate without allocating; acknowledged abort preserves original root, unknown preparation remains blocking
All live activations parked or safely delegated before freeze; collector never waits for operation completion
Guard catches admitted runtime unwind, invalidates marker, records error, retains frame until cleanup is known
Native pin prevents unlink/free through ordinary release and whole-processor cleanup; it is not a GC-exclusion lease
Parent descriptor remains while child activation is live; no stack address resurrection on repeated continuation restore
Close new readers and drain accepted metadata/storage pins before withdrawal; raw value readers require attached-context safepoints

caller.condition: alloc_rc registers current PSTATE before payload assignment; native storage alone is not a nonzero-processor root; proposed VM domain must own both existing RC slot and provisional frame
Explicit proc must be rooted before make_vector can enter GC; initializing marker with #f obeys its constructor contract but does not protect proc_or_false
Allocator GC is an all-processors sync operation; a preparer waiting inside it cannot be a prerequisite for collector root readiness
call can rethrow before normal marker cleanup; explicit completion guards must catch permitted runtime unwind, keep custody, close marker and only then propagate
RC refcount does not protect against cleanup_rc freeing a whole chain; storage pin, owner-exit veto/handoff and final reader drain are distinct from GC scan readiness

protocol.condition: Reserve stable native root-frame storage before dropping any existing root; failure leaves origin custody; reject incoming movable C value without an admissible source root
Accepted intent initializes root cells without allocation and release-publishes them through VM enrollment gate; root-frame publication is not commit of the target RC payload

Before requesting allocating GC, convert mutable-preparation lease to scan-ready custody and stop the attached context; collector waits for preparation closure and parked participants, not operation return
Collector scans all admitted VM domains including processor 1 and writes moved values back; owner reloads through current-epoch cell before marker initialization or RC commit
Failure and supported unwind retain frame until acknowledged terminal outcome, native/reader pins and nested children settle; unknown result is neither quiescence nor permission to free

route.condition: VM intent membership and original-root-to-frame coverage must linearize with collector freeze
Handoff removes GC-blocking preparation while retaining root and storage ownership; operation can remain incomplete
Processor ownership must not exclude temporary frame cells or registered RC payload slots from VM scan
Root reload follows GC completion before use; old copied Scheme words cannot initialize a marker after relocation
Completion guard, readers, storage pins and nested callback identity must close before descriptor withdrawal

gain.avoided: Waiting for the same allocating writer to return before its GC can start
gain.added: Nonallocating preparation, published frame, context park and explicit resume
gain.condition: Finite model reaches collector freeze while operation outcome is pending; native lock/progress refinement remains open

gain.avoided: Repeated reconstruction/copying of a temporary root set on each GC; redundant per-copy publication counters if lifetime coverage already holds
gain.added: One activation frame with k traceable slots, per-GC slot visitation, enrollment and retirement metadata
gain.condition: O(k) retained slots per live activation; reuse of frame does not eliminate tracing or root scanning

gain.avoided: Second-language ownership/exception bridge is unnecessary for this contract
gain.added: Modern C adapters, generated explicit guards, VM root-domain scan and cleanup coordination
gain.condition: C can implement all required mechanisms; neither Zig defer nor a reference count alone handles Gambit nonlocal unwind or whole-PSTATE cleanup

refinement.sourceDuty: Prove source root validity before first safepoint, nonallocating frame initialization, accepted-intent linearization and failure ownership
Compose per-context parking with real sync-op execution and full participant roster; all-owner physical root scan and C publication order remain changes to prove
Separate known runtime unwind from uncooperative foreign exits; commit outcome and root transfer are recorded before delivery; multi-shot continuation receives fresh activation identity
Storage-reader pin is not permission for raw concurrent Scheme-value reads; bound registration and tracing costs without person-day or performance claims

prior.condition: Refines the prior writerGcCycle refusal into a proposed scan-ready handoff; actual product refinement remains open
Root preparation ownership is distinct from active collector worker credit and all-processors sync-op participation
GC payload closure still needs root-domain coverage; nonzero RC scan is a required runtime change

gate.condition: Incoming roots, provisional frames and permanent RC/still adapters require complete source and generated-map coverage
Stable native frame/RC storage must outlive PSTATE cleanup and all reader/borrow pins; real handoff remains unimplemented
No allocation or callback in mutable preparation; parked contexts must still execute or validly delegate their sync-op participant role
Nonzero RC scan and VM provisional-frame adapter are proposed; current processor-zero-only scan cannot qualify them
All runtime throw/catch, nested activation, marker invalidation and unknown-result custody paths need source refinement
New completion guards, gate/enrollment and root descriptors have no runtime implementation or native acceptance
C release/acquire, locks, relocation writeback, signal/native ingress and host attestation are not qualified
